title: Pastel Beaded Phone Charm
description_text: Description: Add a cute and aesthetic touch to your phone with our Pastel Beaded Phone Charm Strap. Designed with a mix of pastel pink beads, pearls, and decorative charms like a butterfly, cross, hearts, and flowers, this strap is both stylish and functional. It securely attaches to your phone case, making it easy to carry while adding a playful accessory vibe. Perfect for everyday use, this charm strap combines durability with pastel elegance.

Description:
Add a cute and aesthetic touch to your phone with our Pastel Beaded Phone Charm Strap. Designed with a mix of pastel pink beads, pearls, and decorative charms like a butterfly, cross, hearts, and flowers, this strap is both stylish and functional. It securely attaches to your phone case, making it easy to carry while adding a playful accessory vibe. Perfect for everyday use, this charm strap combines durability with pastel elegance.
